text:
renee: Quick feedback from design review — playground run history + schema/tool-calling UX. Dropping notes so eng can pick small wins.

ton y: thanks, lay it out please.

renee: 1) Run-history rows render full JSON schema by default. For large schemas this hurts perf and keyboard flow. Suggest a collapsed summary row with a single-line signature and an expand chevron (aria-expanded).

mei: totally. Proposed summary: `Tool: refund_payment(amount:number, id:string)` + chevron. Make chevron reachable by keyboard.

renee: 2) Copy affordance — users often copy the function sig. Add a tiny copy icon that only appears on hover/focus. sr-only label: `Copy signature`. Show a polite aria-live toast on copy.

tony: agree. Keep it unobtrusive. Toast should be dismissible and announced.

renee: 3) Schema editor errors are cryptic. Example shows "invalid schema". We have AJV error objects — format them into plain english and show a short suggestion. e.g., `At required: expected an array of property names (try ["amount"])`.

mei: +1. Also add a small "example fix" expander that reveals a minimal corrected snippet.

devx-bot: accessibility-scan: missing aria-controls linking chevron to the panel, expanded region lacks focus management.

renee: 4) Tool-calling mismatch UI: the current red badge says `schema mismatch` only. We should present a compact key-level diff and allow `Save as new schema version` behind a confirm modal. Prevent accidental overwrites.

aria: security note: saving canonical schema should require a short reason and an optional reviewer field for audit logs.

tony: UX: two tabs in run details: `Output` and `Schema`. Default show: `Output vs schema: 2 keys differ`. Click opens side panel with added/removed/changed key lists. Use key-only diff by default for perf.

mei: keyboard flows: expanding an entry should move focus to the panel. Escape collapses. Tab order within panel must be documented.

devx-bot: color-check: mismatch badge fails small-text AA. Recommend darker red or 1px outline.

renee: ok next steps: can someone sketch the collapsed row + diff side panel with aria notes? Low-fi is fine. I'll collate into a short RFC after.

ton y: I can mock today, including aria attributes and tab order.

mei: I'll draft translations for common AJV errors and post mapping here.

renee: thanks all. If no objections I'll close the thread tomorrow.

ton y: fine by me :+1:

mei: thanks!"
